mentions.name: Context-Link
mentions.description: A white-label RAG API that powers better, more tailored AI features in SaaS products. It indexes customer websites by default and also supports Notion, YouTube, email, and custom connections as data sources.
mentions.problem: SaaS products need tailored AI features grounded in their customers' own data and content.
mentions.audience: SaaS companies looking to add tailored AI features to their products
mentions.source_excerpt: A rag api to power better, more tailored ai features in saas products. By default it indexes customer websites, but also supports notion, YouTube, email and custom connections.
